description: Update an existing task in your organization. Only the fields you provide are changed (PATCH semantics). You can rename the task, update its description, change its status, and set per-type hour limits. Discover ids with find_billing_work - never ask the user for an id.

fix_hour_limit.description: Fixed-price hour limit for this task (0 = unlimited).

idempotency_key.description: Optional caller-supplied key; retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

ovh_hour_limit.description: Overhead hour limit for this task (0 = unlimited).

status.description: Task status. One of: Active, Inactive, Completed.

task_id.description: Id of the task to update (required). Must be a task in your organization.

tm_hour_limit.description: T&M (Time & Materials) hour limit for this task (0 = unlimited).

name: update_task
